title: Extra-Guest-Fee Refunds and Roamhaven Rewards Credits (Training Q&A)
content:
# Training Q&A — extra-guest-fee refunds where Roamhaven Rewards credits paid part of the stay

**The rule.** When Roamhaven Rewards credits paid part of a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, the credit-funded part of the extra-guest-fee refund goes back as credits and only the rest is paid to the card: when credits were redeemed on the stay and none of them has been reinstated yet, the card receives the extra-guest-fee refund times one minus the credits redeemed divided by the stay's total price; when credits were redeemed on the stay and part of them has already been reinstated, the card receives the extra-guest-fee refund times one minus the credits still outstanding (redeemed less reinstated) divided by the stay's total price; otherwise, including when no credits were redeemed, the card receives the whole extra-guest-fee refund. The card part is taken before the single rounding to the cent.

**Where are the credits read?**
In the guest's Roamhaven Rewards ledger: the credits redeemed on the stay and the credits reinstated on it. The total price is the one recorded on the stay.

**Worked: 300.00 redeemed, nothing reinstated, total price 1,500.00, refund 50.00 before the split.**
Card part: 50.00 times one minus 300.00 divided by 1,500.00, that is 50.00 times 0.80, which is 40.00.

**Worked: the same, with 100.00 already reinstated.**
Outstanding credits 200.00; card part 50.00 times one minus 200.00 divided by 1,500.00, that is about 43.33.

**Worked: no credits redeemed on the stay.**
The card receives the whole 50.00.
